cohort: 385 mothers without contraindications to breastfeeding at a tertiary care center in Bhubaneswar, India
finding: The study revealed a decline in timely breastfeeding initiation in Odisha, India, with only 36.4% of mothers initiating breastfeeding within the recommended timeframe.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a higher rate of timely breastfeeding initiation compared to cesarean section (41.3% vs. unspecified, P = 0.016).
